text:
📢 This Week at Cyber Club
📍 CM 22, Room 125 (behind the library) • 🕔 5–7 PM
🗓️ Tue 9/29: Career Fair Prep
Resume reviews, certs worth knowing, and study resources. Bring your resume!
Preps you for Thursday's career fair and makes the Oct 15 Tech Career Fair way easier.
🔗 Career Fair (Oct 1): https://app.joinhandshake.com/stu/career_fairs/65247
🔗 Tech Career Fair (Oct 15): https://app.joinhandshake.com/stu/career_fairs/65252
💼 NextEra is at both. NCCI is at Oct 1, so go to that one for their infrastructure job!
🗓️ Thu 10/1: CyberPatriot Practice Image Day 🛡️
We'll download CyberPatriot practice VMs and try to secure them. Great way to get good at defensive comps! Bring your laptop 💻
📊 Practice images: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cdVHtk4w5JDJCYy-EO2_ycr0ZqMgUyjFOVDn5Y8eGVw/edit?gid=735920429
💿 VMware Workstation Pro installers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Lf7qnJSXf9q1KHE8IzPvySEZRyUHutfL
To load an image: unzip it, then double-click the .vmx file (icon looks like a text file). It'll import straight into VMware.
⏩ Install VMware and download an image before Thursday so we can jump right in!
🍎 Mac users: VMware Workstation won't run on Macs, and M-series Macs usually can't run these images. Pair up with someone on Windows!
🗓️ Sat 10/3: WRCCDC Practice #1 🔥
Our first WRCCDC practice! Great prep for Horse Plinko (and it's gonna be harder). Max 12 people, but anyone who wants to try it, show up!
💻 We need VPNs on our computers, so we may do it at someone's house with laptops. I'll lend out my spare laptop so more people can play.
👉 Reply or DM me if you're in! Time + location TBA.
🏢 NCCI Data Center Tour: Tue, Oct 6 • 5:00–5:30 PM
Huge thanks to [Wade Thomas](<https://www.linkedin.com/in/wadethomas/>), Information Security & Operations Manager at NCCI, for making this happen!
📍 901 Peninsula Corp Cir, Boca Raton, FL 33487
🚗 Congress Ave exit off I-95, straight through the light, second entrance. Park and go to the main entrance guard desk.
🪪 Government-issued ID required. Student ID is NOT enough.
📝 Spots are limited! Sign up: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc_l3btxSU0p6k9FXOoWLNUjA354A0cXY1pS4WTIWWJMlPrKg/viewform
🎤 Speaker Lineup (Updated!)
🔴 Oct 15: [Zachary Bright](<https://www.linkedin.com/in/zachbright/>), ADT
🔴 Oct 22: Kyle Ryan, NextEra Energy *(moved from Oct 8)*
🔴 Oct 29: [Delia Drumm](<https://www.linkedin.com/in/deliadrumm/>), Microsoft
🆕 Nov 5: [Rod Soto](<https://www.linkedin.com/in/rod-soto/>), Splunk, creator of the SFISSA CTF!
🆕 TBA: [Bryant Pickford](<https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryant-p-623380189/>), Senior AI Security Cloud Solutions Architect, Microsoft (met him at HackSpaceCon!)

author: shaamad
text:
🚨 SHPE National Convention: ACTION NEEDED TONIGHT 🚨
 is a SHPE officer and invited us to come to the SHPE National Convention with them! Companies include Microsoft, Datadog, Abbott, SpaceX, Lockheed Martin, HP, Lenovo, Eli Lilly, Apple and more. SHPE has done on-site interviews before, so this is a real shot at landing a job or internship.
🗺️ Floor plan (all companies): https://rocexhibitions.expocad.com/Events/26shpee/index.html
💰 Price
- $470 with SHPE membership / $860 without
- 👉 Sign up for SHPE National membership ($5) first, *then* register to get the member price
🔗 Registration: https://web.cvent.com/event/432b07e5-d865-4514-aa53-5377ab9c37c5/summary
✅ To get reimbursed, do ALL of this by END OF DAY TODAY
Gianluca submits the student travel request tomorrow morning and can't add anyone after that.
1️⃣ Fill out the interest form: https://forms.gle/c7uXVWeb5Dnn54gDA
2️⃣ Buy your SHPE membership + convention ticket tonight
3️⃣ Pass the Student Travel Course and screenshot your passing result: https://canvas.fau.edu/enroll/8NDTMY
4️⃣ DM for the Code of Conduct form and e-sign it
5️⃣ DM (not in this channel!) your Z-number, mailing address, ticket confirmation screenshot, and travel course screenshot
💬 Convention group chat: https://chat.whatsapp.com/I0WWq5bUDVLBKKSa4kDw8J
⚠️ Please read
- Reimbursement is likely but not guaranteed. It covers the convention registration. Flights aren't confirmed yet (still asking the College of Engineering).
- After the event you'll need to show proof you went (photo wearing your badge + registration). If you register and don't go, you'll probably lose the money.
- You can still go if you miss tonight, but reimbursement probably won't be possible.
